title: Alekhine Defense: Four Pawns Attack
line: White takes all the space offered with four pawns; Black's pieces attack the big center.

steps.text: In the Alekhine, White's pawn chases the knight and a second pawn joins it in the center.
Black hits the front pawn, a third pawn chases the knight again, and in the Four Pawns Attack a fourth comes forward.
Take the pawn on e5. The file opens, and your queen now looks at the pawn on d4.
Bring the other knight out. It hits the pawns on e5 and d4.

also.c8f5: That also works. This lesson brings the knight out first.

steps.text: Push the pawn on e7 one square, so your other bishop can come out.
Bring the bishop out, so you can castle.

also.f8b4: That also works. This lesson puts the bishop on e7.

steps.text: White's pawn hits your knight. Take the pawn.
Jump to b4 with the knight. It eyes d5 and c2.
steps.after: White's front pawn is attacked by both your knights, and the big center has broken up.

summary: Against the Four Pawns, Black's pieces hit the big center from every side until the pawns break up.
